messages:
maya_s: Heads up — after last night's KMS rewrap we observed an embeddings route returning 200 for a chat-scoped token. Minimal repro below, filing here before paging.

maya_s: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-chat-only-XXXX' -H 'X-Route: /v1/embeddings' https://api.internal.redwood/api/generate
maya_s: 
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model": "text-embed-001", "data": [...] }

jonah_w: ack. do we know if the token was rotated/rewrapped or if the authz service changed?

maya_s: KMS rewrap completed @ 02:12 UTC. Authz deployment #r2463 went at 01:50 (small RBAC refactor: add role tags). Suspect timing overlap.

leo: adding quick note — the refactor removed a legacy per-route tag check in authz middleware and relied on model-level tags. embeddings vs chat used to be separate checks. might be a regression.

atila: can you paste the token id (masked) and the audit token id? I want to grep logs + KMS tags.

maya_s: token-id: tok_****7a3b, audit-token: atok-99f. grep shows accept at 02:27:13 UTC.

ops-oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1542 — severity: medium — triggered by anomalous scope match on embeddings route. Paging oncall.

audit-bot: quick audit run: found 12 authz.log entries for tok_****7a3b between 02:15-02:40 UTC. Policy decision: ALLOW. Reason: missing route_allowlist check (field absent) — fallback to model_tag match returned true.

jonah_w: that matches theory: KMS rewrap may have updated key tags first, and the authz refactor expects route_allowlist tag to exist. if absent, we fall back to model_tag which is more permissive for chat tokens.

leo: short-term mitigation: 1) revoke tok_****7a3b, 2) add a hard deny in the gateway for chat-scoped tokens hitting /v1/embeddings until patch is out.

atila: I'll run a targeted lookup in KMS metadata for the rewrap job timeline. also want to check if any other tokens inherited permissive tags.

maya_s: revoked the token and rotated the client's key. Confirmed new requests now 403.

jonah_w: I'll push an emergency guard to authn gateway: enforce explicit per-route scope check for embeddings endpoint. Patch prepared, will canary to staging then prod.

audit-bot: query results: 23 tokens created/rewrapped in that window. 3 had missing route_allowlist tag after rewrap. KMS job 2026-03-18T02:12:01Z shows a successful rewrap run with job_id kwrap-20260318-21.

leo: follow-ups: - rollback RBAC refactor or add compatibility shim to ensure route_allowlist is present post-rewrap - add audit assertion to KMS rewrap pipeline to preserve route_allowlist tag - create an automated smoke test that verifies chat tokens cannot hit embeddings endpoints

atila: I'll open a KMS pipeline PR to add tag-preservation and a unit test.

maya_s: jotting postmortem notes: timeline + tokens + mitigations. can we aim for a short postmortem by EOD?

jonah_w: yes. I'll draft root cause: authz refactor + KMS rewrap tag drift + missing fallback hardened check.

ops-oncall-bot: INC-2026-1542 updated: mitigations applied, paging cleared.

leo: runbook items: - force re-run of rewrap job with tag sync for affected customers - emergency alert rule: any authz decision that results in ALLOW where route_allowlist missing should generate an event

maya_s: thanks all. small thing: add test case to CI: simulate rewrap dropping custom tag then verify gateway denies chat->embeddings.

atila: noted. PRs incoming.

jonah_w: assigning owners: leo (authz patch), atila (KMS pipeline), maya_s (PM + postmortem), jonah_w (gateway guard + deploy).

maya_s: @here appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
